name: dnbg-plugins
about: An opinionated software factory, packaged as a set of Claude Code plugins. AI-driven, human-directed, with built-in retrospectives that surface friction to fix. Honed over its first 7 months of real use across 35 repos, ~2k PRs, 1.2M+ lines of code, and 10 languages. Still sharpening.

name: aws-use
about: Switch AWS SSO accounts and roles fast, across several SSO sessions at once, and set the profile in your current shell.

name: git-tidy
about: A git subcommand that deletes branches whose work has already landed, removes their worktrees, fast-forwards the default branch and runs git gc.

name: Landfall
about: A map for listings posted at a location. Screen the candidates, see where they are, and plan the drive to the ones worth a visit.

name: Sweet Land Math
about: Grow a field of crops by practicing times tables, harvest them, and build a community with what you sell.

name: OASIS SMP
about: A hosted Minecraft server co-created with my kiddo for his school.

name: SAW Auto-Clicker
about: An auto-clicker my kiddo asked for so he didn't have to trust one from a shady website. Hold the mouse button and it clicks at a set rate, only in the apps you allow.
